docs.title: Knowledge Library / 知识库
docs.text:
Welcome — this site is a personal knowledge library in English and 中文.

Top-level categories / 顶级分类:

  • Understanding — 世界如何运作
  • Building — 我要创造什么
  • Investing — 我要押注什么
  • Journal — 我学到了什么

Use the English and 中文 sections under each category.
